blocks.t: 1.) Insert Pursuit program card into the test fixture (TF101)
and then connect the board to be tested.
2.) Turn the AC power switch on.
3.) Depress the coin switch once to start the game.
4.) Joy stick #3 controls the firing by pushing the stick to the
right. The horizontal plane motion is controlled by the potentiometer
on the left side of the program card. The vertical control is on
the right side of the program card.
NOTE: Some of the components on this program card do get warm.
